steps.cmd:
export UV_TOOL_DIR="$install_root/uv-tools"
export UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR="$install_root/bin"
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$install_root/uv-cache"
mkdir -p "$UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR"
uv tool install --force --python /workspace/.kf/bin/python3 'codex-relay==0.5.5'

cat > "$install_root/bin/kite-codex-app-server" <<'KITE_CODEX_APP_SERVER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
upstream_file='/workspace/.kf/secrets/kite.codex-relay-upstream'
api_key_file='/workspace/.kf/secrets/kite.codex-relay-api-key'
relay_log='/workspace/.kf/logs/codex-responses-relay.log'
if [ ! -s "$upstream_file" ]; then exec codex app-server "$@"; fi
relay_pid=''
proxy_pid=''
stop_pid() {
  target_pid="$1"
  if [ -n "$target_pid" ] && kill -0 "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$target_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
cleanup() {
  stop_pid "$relay_pid"
  stop_pid "$proxy_pid"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 129' HUP
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
upstream="$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$upstream_file")"
if [ -z "$upstream" ]; then echo 'Codex relay upstream missing' >&2; exit 2; fi
if [ -s "$api_key_file" ]; then export CODEX_RELAY_API_KEY="$(cat "$api_key_file")"; else unset CODEX_RELAY_API_KEY; fi
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$relay_log")"
: > "$relay_log"
chmod 600 "$relay_log"
case "$upstream" in
  https://*)
    launcher_path="$(readlink -f "$0")"
    proxy_script="$(dirname "$launcher_path")/kite-codex-upstream-proxy"
    KITE_CODEX_UPSTREAM="$upstream" KITE_CODEX_PROXY_PORT=4454 node "$proxy_script" >> "$relay_log" 2>&1 &
    proxy_pid=$!
    ready=0
    attempts=0
    while [ "$attempts" -lt 120 ]; do
      if ! kill -0 "$proxy_pid" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'Codex upstream proxy exited during startup' >&2; exit 2; fi
      if (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/4454) 2>/dev/null; then exec 3>&-; exec 3<&-; ready=1; break; fi
      attempts=$((attempts + 1))
      sleep 0.1
    done
    if [ "$ready" -ne 1 ]; then echo 'Codex upstream proxy startup timed out' >&2; exit 2; fi
    export CODEX_RELAY_UPSTREAM='http://127.0.0.1:4454'
    ;;
  *) export CODEX_RELAY_UPSTREAM="$upstream" ;;
esac
codex-relay --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 4453 >> "$relay_log" 2>&1 &
relay_pid=$!
ready=0
attempts=0
while [ "$attempts" -lt 120 ]; do
  if ! kill -0 "$relay_pid" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'Codex relay exited during startup' >&2; exit 2; fi
  if (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/4453) 2>/dev/null; then exec 3>&-; exec 3<&-; ready=1; break; fi
  attempts=$((attempts + 1))
  sleep 0.1
done
if [ "$ready" -ne 1 ]; then echo 'Codex relay startup timed out' >&2; exit 2; fi
codex app-server "$@"
KITE_CODEX_APP_SERVER
chmod 755 "$install_root/bin/kite-codex-app-server"

steps.cmd:
set -eu
persistence_js="$install_root/npm-global/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js"
test -f "$persistence_js"
if grep -Fq 'await link(tmp, finalPath);' "$persistence_js"; then
  sed -i 's/import { link, mkdir, mkdtemp, open, readFile, readdir, realpath, rm, stat, truncate }/import { mkdir, mkdtemp, open, readFile, readdir, realpath, rename, rm, stat, truncate }/' "$persistence_js"
  sed -i 's/await link(tmp, finalPath);/await rename(tmp, finalPath);/' "$persistence_js"
fi
grep -Fq 'await rename(tmp, finalPath);' "$persistence_js"
grep -Fq 'realpath, rename, rm' "$persistence_js"

set -eu
acp_root="$install_root/npm-global/lib/node_modules/@openma/deepseek-harness-acp/dist"
for acp_js in "$acp_root/bridge.js" "$acp_root/plugin.js" "$acp_root/server.js"; do
  test -f "$acp_js"
  if grep -Fq 'requireCredential(config.provider)' "$acp_js"; then
    sed -i 's/requireCredential(config.provider)/requireCredential(defaultProvider())/g' "$acp_js"
  fi
  if grep -Fq 'requireCredential(record.provider ?? config.provider)' "$acp_js"; then
    sed -i 's/requireCredential(record.provider ?? config.provider)/requireCredential(routeOf(record).provider)/g' "$acp_js"
  fi
  test "$(grep -Fc 'requireCredential(defaultProvider())' "$acp_js")" -eq 2
  test "$(grep -Fc 'requireCredential(routeOf(record).provider)' "$acp_js")" -eq 2
  ! grep -Fq 'requireCredential(config.provider)' "$acp_js"
  ! grep -Fq 'requireCredential(record.provider ?? config.provider)' "$acp_js"
done

set -eu
mkdir -p "$install_root/bin" "$install_root/user-home/.dsh"
cat > "$install_root/bin/kite-dsh-acp" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
export HOME="$install_root/user-home"
export DSH_HOME="$install_root/user-home/.dsh"
dsh_bin="\$(command -v dsh)"
[ -n "\$dsh_bin" ] || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=prepare step=deepseek-harness-host reason=dsh-missing' >&2; exit 127; }
export DSH_PATH="\$dsh_bin"
exec dsh-acp "\$@"
EOF
chmod 755 "$install_root/bin/kite-dsh-acp"

verify.cmd: persistence_js="$install_root/npm-global/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js" && grep -Fq 'await rename(tmp, finalPath);' "$persistence_js" && grep -Fq 'realpath, rename, rm' "$persistence_js"

acp_root="$install_root/npm-global/lib/node_modules/@openma/deepseek-harness-acp/dist" && for acp_js in "$acp_root/bridge.js" "$acp_root/plugin.js" "$acp_root/server.js"; do test "$(grep -Fc 'requireCredential(defaultProvider())' "$acp_js")" -eq 2 && test "$(grep -Fc 'requireCredential(routeOf(record).provider)' "$acp_js")" -eq 2 && ! grep -Fq 'requireCredential(config.provider)' "$acp_js" && ! grep -Fq 'requireCredential(record.provider ?? config.provider)' "$acp_js" || exit 1; done

steps.cmd:
mkdir -p "$install_root/home" "$install_root/user-home" "/workspace/.kf/cache/resources/kite.hermes.core/uv"
cat > "$install_root/kite-install-core-acp.sh" <<'KITE_HERMES_INSTALL'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
: "${KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT:?KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT is required}"
repo_dir="$KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT/hermes-agent"
command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=prepare step=hermes-python reason=uv-missing'; exit 127; }
agent_python=""
for candidate in /usr/bin/python3.13 /usr/bin/python3.12 /usr/bin/python3.11; do
  if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then
    agent_python="$candidate"
    break
  fi
done
[ -n "$agent_python" ] || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=prepare step=hermes-python reason=compatible-system-python-missing'; exit 127; }
agent_python_version="$("$agent_python" -c 'import sys; print(f"{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}")')"
case "$agent_python_version" in
  3.11|3.12|3.13) ;;
  *) echo "KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=prepare step=hermes-python reason=unsupported-version version=$agent_python_version"; exit 65 ;;
esac
echo "KITE_RESOURCE_STEP prepare hermes-python-$agent_python_version source=system"
echo "KITE_RESOURCE_STEP install hermes-core-acp python=$agent_python"
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP acquire hermes-python-packages source=aliyun'
if timeout 600 env UV_DEFAULT_INDEX="https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple/" UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$repo_dir/venv" UV_PYTHON="$agent_python" uv sync --project "$repo_dir" --locked --no-default-groups --extra acp; then
  echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP acquire-complete hermes-python-packages source=aliyun'
else
  mirror_status=$?
  echo "KITE_RESOURCE_RETRY stage=acquire step=hermes-python-packages source=aliyun exit=$mirror_status"
  rm -rf "$repo_dir/venv"
  echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP acquire hermes-python-packages source=pypi'
  env UV_DEFAULT_INDEX="https://pypi.org/simple" UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$repo_dir/venv" UV_PYTHON="$agent_python" uv sync --project "$repo_dir" --locked --no-default-groups --extra acp
  echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP acquire-complete hermes-python-packages source=pypi'
fi
[ -x "$repo_dir/venv/bin/hermes" ] || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-core-acp reason=entrypoint-missing'; exit 127; }
printf '%s\n' 'core+acp' > "$KITE_HERMES_INSTALL_ROOT/install-profile"
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP install-complete hermes-core-acp'
KITE_HERMES_INSTALL
chmod +x "$install_root/kite-install-core-acp.sh"

agent_python="$install_root/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python"
session_file="$install_root/hermes-agent/acp_adapter/session.py"
test -x "$agent_python" || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-acp-provider-identity reason=python-missing'; exit 127; }
test -f "$session_file" || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-acp-provider-identity reason=session-source-missing'; exit 66; }
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP patch hermes-acp-provider-identity'
"$agent_python" - "$session_file" <<'KITE_HERMES_PROVIDER_PATCH'
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

target = Path(sys.argv[1])
source = target.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
import_old = 'from hermes_cli.runtime_provider import resolve_runtime_provider'
import_new = 'from hermes_cli.runtime_provider import canonical_custom_identity, resolve_runtime_provider'
if import_new not in source:
    if import_old not in source:
        raise SystemExit('Hermes runtime provider import contract changed')
    source = source.replace(import_old, import_new, 1)

persist_anchor = '        api_mode = getattr(state.agent, "api_mode", None)\n'
persist_marker = '            provider = canonical_custom_identity(\n'
if persist_marker not in source:
    if persist_anchor not in source:
        raise SystemExit('Hermes ACP persistence contract changed')
    persist_patch = persist_anchor + (
        '        if isinstance(provider, str) and provider.strip().lower() == "custom":\n'
        '            provider = canonical_custom_identity(\n'
        '                base_url=base_url if isinstance(base_url, str) else None,\n'
        '                model=model_str,\n'
        '            ) or provider\n'
    )
    source = source.replace(persist_anchor, persist_patch, 1)

persist_import = '            from hermes_cli.runtime_provider import canonical_custom_identity\n'
if persist_import not in source:
    if persist_marker not in source:
        raise SystemExit('Hermes ACP persistence provider contract changed')
    source = source.replace(persist_marker, persist_import + persist_marker, 1)

restore_old = '            runtime = resolve_runtime_provider(requested=requested_provider or config_provider)'
restore_marker = '            runtime_provider = requested_provider or config_provider'
if restore_marker not in source:
    if restore_old not in source:
        raise SystemExit('Hermes ACP restore contract changed')
    restore_patch = (
        '            runtime_provider = requested_provider or config_provider\n'
        '            if str(runtime_provider or "").strip().lower() == "custom":\n'
        '                runtime_provider = canonical_custom_identity(\n'
        '                    base_url=base_url,\n'
        '                    config_provider=config_provider,\n'
        '                    model=model or default_model,\n'
        '                ) or runtime_provider\n'
        '            runtime = resolve_runtime_provider(requested=runtime_provider)'
    )
    source = source.replace(restore_old, restore_patch, 1)

compile(source, str(target), 'exec')
temporary = target.with_name(target.name + '.kite-pending')
temporary.write_text(source, encoding='utf-8')
os.replace(temporary, target)
KITE_HERMES_PROVIDER_PATCH
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP patch-complete hermes-acp-provider-identity'

agent_python="$install_root/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python"
server_file="$install_root/hermes-agent/acp_adapter/server.py"
test -x "$agent_python" || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-acp-model-selection reason=python-missing'; exit 127; }
test -f "$server_file" || { echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_FAILURE stage=install step=hermes-acp-model-selection reason=server-source-missing'; exit 66; }
echo 'KITE_RESOURCE_STEP patch hermes-acp-model-selection'
"$agent_python" - "$server_file" <<'KITE_HERMES_MODEL_PATCH'
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

target = Path(sys.argv[1])
source = target.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
anchor = '        target_provider = current_provider\n        new_model = raw_model.strip()\n\n'
marker = '        # Kite compatibility: resolve named custom ACP choices before generic parsing.\n'
if marker not in source:
    if anchor not in source:
        raise SystemExit('Hermes ACP model selection contract changed')
    patch = anchor + (
        marker
        + '        try:\n'
        + '            from hermes_cli.models import _configured_custom_provider_ids\n\n'
        + '            configured = (\n'
        + '                str(provider_id).strip().lower()\n'
        + '                for provider_id in _configured_custom_provider_ids()\n'
        + '                if str(provider_id).strip().lower().startswith("custom:")\n'
        + '            )\n'
        + '            lowered = new_model.lower()\n'
        + '            for candidate in sorted(configured, key=len, reverse=True):\n'
        + '                prefix = candidate + ":"\n'
        + '                if lowered.startswith(prefix):\n'
        + '                    return candidate, new_model[len(prefix):]\n'
        + '        except Exception:\n'
        + '            logger.debug("Named custom provider detection failed", exc_info=True)\n\n'
    )
    source = source.replace(anchor, patch, 1)

compile(source, str(target), 'exec')
temporary = target.with_name(target.name + '.kite-pending')
temporary.write_text(source, encoding='utf-8')
os.replace(temporary, target)
